summary: Ground truth is dataset-derived, but the archived evaluation fails integrity review because 189/200 diagnostic records are training samples, D1 was reconstructed with the wrong model configuration, metric metadata/normalization conflict, and no formal multi-seed or official-test result is archived.

gt_provenance.details: Dataset-provided GT is used, but the archived slice was mislabeled: 11 records are held out and 189 are training records.

score_normalization.details: Independent normalization uses prediction statistics and hides scale error; diagnostic and formal paths use different coordinate conventions; evaluate.py metadata conflicts with squared-distance computation.

result_existence.details: JSON summaries exist and recompute, but D1 used the wrong reconstructed architecture and the results are not bound to complete checkpoint/config/data/code hashes.

dead_code.details: Formal metrics are called in evaluate.py, but the paper results bypass that path; the formal evaluator is incompatible with the wrapped training checkpoint as written.

scope.details: One dataset, one 4x patch setting, one seed per configuration, and only an 11-record post-hoc held-out intersection; no formal 127-model test output.

claims.note: Exploratory only on the 11-record held-out intersection.
cv_nn improves 4.84%, while CD and HD worsen 2.80% and 13.43%.
All four reported metrics are worse.
